data.title: Aykon City
data.about:
Damac’s Aykon City is home to a beautifully crafted high-rise community nestled perfectly on the banks of the Dubai Canal. Akon City offers you a choice of spacious and exquisite apartments and a lifestyle like no other. 

There are 4 towers standing tall close to the Burj Area and Business Bay, on the Sheikh Zayed Road, amidst the dynamic community. Located minutes away from City Walk, DIFC, and Box Park, Aykon City is in proximity to gourmet restaurants, shopping centres and many entertainment facilities.

As a resident of Aykon City, you will have access to the world-class amenities which include  Sun Pool, Cabanas & Lounge Splash Pad, Lawn Area, Formal Lap Pool, Children’s Play Area, Lounge Deck, Spa, Floating Palms, Beach Club, Water Lounge Bar, Retail Outlets, Elevated Timber Path, Running Track, Dining & Cafe Culture, Yoga Lawn and more.

characteristics_module.title: Easy access to the rest of the city
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points

location_tile.title: Just minutes away from the most iconic landmarks
location_tile.description:
Aykon Heights is the perfect location and right in the middle of the bustling global city. Located in the golden quadrant of the Sheikh Zayed Road, by the Dubai Water Canal, in Business Bay.

  • 9 Minutes Burj Khalifa/Dubai Mall
  • 10 Minutes Mall of Emirates
  • 9 Minutes Jumeirah Beach
  • 16 Minutes Palm Jumeirah
  • 14 Minutes Burj Al Arab
  • 16 Minutes Dubai Yacht Harbour
  • 13 Minutes Dubai Intl Airport
  • 8  Minutes Dubai World Trade Centre
  • 10 Minutes International School
  • 20 Minutes Super Market
